# Copilot Instructions

Before making changes, read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [RALLYLOOP_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md](../RALLYLOOP_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md), then inspect the relevant code.

Follow the approved scope and current implementation phase. Make focused changes, preserve existing behavior, add relevant tests, and run the project's applicable checks. Do not start a later phase or add dependencies, services, or product features without approval.

For each implementation task, summarize the approach and expected files first when changes span multiple files. Finish by reporting changes, validation results, assumptions, and remaining work. Never include real credentials in source, chat, or commits.
